 */
export function cacheLife(profile: 'max'): void

/**
 * Cache this `"use cache"` using a custom profile "...".
 * ```
 *   stale: ... // seconds

  revalidate?: number
  /**
   * If this entry has no traffic for ... seconds it will expire. The next request will recompute it.
   */
  expire?: number
}): void

This implementation demonstrates proper cache invalidation patterns for dynamic data updates in a Next.js application using the latest caching APIs. The timestamp will update only when the cache is invalidated and re-fetched.
